name: Infinite Volume Forward Scattering Propagator
definition: An approximate evaluation of the functional integral for infinite volume forward scattering, derived using a connection to polymer physics and a modified length constraint. It serves as the base propagator before boundary conditions are applied.
summary: The Infinite Volume Forward Scattering Propagator is an analytical approximation for light transport in optically dense media that explicitly encodes scattering anisotropy to capture the transition from ballistic to diffusive transport.
